tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App page background behind all content.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table surfaces, modals.

tokens.name: surface-card-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list rows and clickable cards on surface-card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: High-emphasis dark panel, e.g. the 'Overall Performance' summary block.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar navigation background. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text field and select backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-input-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled/inactive field background.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Default card, table and input borders; dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised borders, dashed drop zones, active input outline base.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholder labels on surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text, placeholder input copy.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-sidebar and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav labels on surface-sidebar.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Primary brand accent: active nav item fill, key highlights, links on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on brand-accent fills.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Secondary brand mark colour; section rules and small brand accents on light surfaces.

tokens.name: action-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (e.g. 'Add New Note', 'Submit').

tokens.name: action-primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on action-primary-bg.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the primary button.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline on interactive controls, 2px, offset 2px, on any surface.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Background for success/paid/completed badges.

tokens.name: status-success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-success-bg; success icons.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background for failed/urgent/error badges.

tokens.name: status-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-danger-bg; error icons. Kept off pure red toward vermilion so it never reads the same as status-success by hue alone.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background for pending/in-progress badges.

tokens.name: status-warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-warning-bg.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Background for informational/new badges.

tokens.name: status-info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-info-bg.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Calendar / reservation tag colour, category 1.

tokens.name: accent-violet-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill for accent-violet chips and calendar events.

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Calendar / reservation tag colour, category 2.

tokens.name: accent-amber-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill for accent-amber chips and calendar events.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Calendar / reservation tag colour, category 3.

tokens.name: accent-teal-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill for accent-teal chips and calendar events.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary series in bar and area charts (Bookings, Revenue).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Secondary chart series (e.g. Hotels slice).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary chart series (e.g. Adventures slice).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Quaternary chart series (e.g. Dry Cleaning slice).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page-hero numerals only; used sparingly, e.g. a cover metric.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Panel headings inside a dark summary block.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Page title in the top header bar, e.g. 'Calendar', 'Rooms'.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Large KPI numbers on stat cards (e.g. '12,847').

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, nav labels, table cells.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy, input labels, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat card captions, badge text, table column headers (uppercased).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact control padding, chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding, small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card padding, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card-to-card gaps in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding, primary grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section separation.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero / top-of-page spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Maximum rhythm step, empty-state vertical spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, badges' inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, table rows, calendar day cells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, sidebar active item.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large hero panels, image cards (room photos).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, chips, avatar frames, toggle tracks.

tokens.usage: Resting elevation for cards on surface-page.

tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown menus, floating action bars.
